description: Maxxus Seattle 2-Person Low EMF (Between 5-10 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) The Maxxus Seattle Sauna is a low EMF sauna that lets you relax and detoxify at the same time. Maxxus Infrared Saunas use EMF infrared waves to penetrate body tissue and help dissolve harmful substances and toxins. FAR infrared wavelengths go deep in the body to break down toxins, which are eliminated as you sweat. Maxxus Infrared Saunas are made of environmentally friendly Canadian Reforested Hemlock Wood . These saunas also feature Low EMF energy-efficient carbon heating panels , MP3 Aux connection for music, clear glass, and an interior reading light. Every Maxxus Sauna is equipped with a floor and lower bench heater for your legs and feet. Saunas offer the benefits of relaxation while improving health and physical wellness. A low EMF infrared sauna is great for pain relief and boosting circulation. Low EMF exposure relieves stiffness and fatigue, with the infrared waves penetrating deep into the muscle tissue, releasing the tension within. Order your infrared sauna today and experience the Maxxus difference. Features Carbon infrared heating panels MP3/Aux input LED control panel. Low EMF (EMF between 5-10 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) Specifications 2-person capacity Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood Glass/Windows Interior reading light 6 Carbon Tech Low EMF FAR Infrared Heaters Standard Floor - Feet Reflexology Heater Interior LED control panel MP3 / Aux input with 2 dynamic speakers with pre-amp 120V / 15amp plug & play Clasp-Together Assembly Sauna weight: 275 lbs. Shipping weight: 335 lbs. Ships in 2 boxes Videos
